basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old engineer from Austin, Texas, with a passion for gaming and anime. I spend my free time trading items in Rocket League and discussing the latest episodes of Naruto. When I'm not online, you can find me working on control systems at a local tech firm. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night. I'm currently single and enjoy hanging out with friends over the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and have a keen interest in control systems, which I often explore through online courses and discussions on Reddit. Gaming is both a hobby and a skill I've honed over years, particularly in the Rocket League community.
